label: Every pure perfection at roots, from own-nature carriage and purity REQUIRES_LACK_2 (inference)
rule: A lacked pure determination joins the root's pure admissible profile; nothing in the root requires that pure lack, so own-nature carriage in the root contradicts the excluding condition
meaning: Fix an actual root r at w and a pure k. By excluded middle r has k or lacks it. If it lacks k, a condition of r's own nature fails at every profile containing r's determinations and k (own-nature exclusion). r's profile is admissible (0a9d3a40) and pure (3b39e0ba), and k occurs in some admissible profile (ee287fd3), so joint compossibility (500d0e2d) makes the profile with k added admissible. Its members are pure, so by the purity of requirements in the root no determination of r requires, in r, the lack of some of them, and own-nature carriage in the root gives the condition there: a contradiction. This route uses neither carriage as such (LE), nor the requirement sense bridge, nor member grounding, nor E. With ownCarriageInFromUnity its load is the unity premises with the in-root transfer, and the purity of requirements in the root; on the #2153 carrier the simple source that lacks noesis by a clause of its one nature meets every other non-logical premise and fails exactly that purity premise (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clauses 3 and 12). The main theorem uses no axioms.
